facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/mtx:.bss
facts.existing_value: The two descriptors begin as zero-initialized static storage and are transitioned during HSD object startup into separate empty, registered pool states. Initialization removes any prior registry occurrence, clears the descriptor, restores default unlimited allocation limits, sets an alignment mask of 3, records a stride equal to sizeof(Vec) or sizeof(Mtx), and reinserts the descriptor at the allocator-registry head. Subsequent allocation and release operations update each pool's free-list and usage counters independently.
